clue.text: Bank agent meets huge politician, one to be entertained

indicators.note: a guest entertained is taken in, so the numeral goes inside the assembled letters

parts.note: a rep is a sales agent, short for representative
OS is the clothing-size abbreviation for outsize
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party
the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A financial agent meets an enormous Conservative MP and has one more guest to entertain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bank' is a store, not a riverbank or lender; 'to be entertained' has the agent, size and politician take the one in as a guest.
explanation.definitionFit: A bank is a store where things are deposited and kept, as in a blood bank or a data store.

clue.text: Register money being in short supply

indicators.note: short here means cut short, so the word for money loses its final letter

parts.note: ready, or readies, is slang for cash

explanation.surface: A cash register when money is scarce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in short supply' docks the last letter of READY.
explanation.definitionFit: A meter or gauge that registers a value is said to show that reading, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Most stylish female in office

indicators.note: the female pronoun sits inside the word for office

parts.note: a post is a job or office held
she is the female pronoun

explanation.surface: The smartest-dressed woman in the workplace.
explanation.definitionFit: Posh is informal British for smart or upmarket, so its superlative means most stylish.

clue.text: No sons of gloom will be excited by this set of love poems

indicators.note: excited letters are stirred up and jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Cheerless young men will be cheered by these romantic verses.
explanation.definitionFit: This book of the Old Testament, also called the Song of Songs, is a cycle of erotic love poetry.

clue.text: Like heavy material getting thin after short time

indicators.note: the word for thin comes after the time abbreviation

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time
weedy means thin and weak

explanation.surface: Cloth getting thinner after a brief while.
explanation.definitionFit: Tweed is a thick woollen cloth, so something resembling that heavy fabric is described this way.

clue.text: Prepares again to control son sinking to the bottom

indicators.note: the son's letter drops down to the end of this down entry

parts.note: to restrain is to hold in check

explanation.surface: A coach prepares a struggling son again as he sinks to the bottom of the table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sinking to the bottom' moves the S of RESTRAIN to the end; in a down clue the end is the bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: To retrain is to teach or coach someone afresh, preparing them once more for a task.

clue.text: Unpopular worker provided with cards ultimately, then taxi

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word cards

parts.note: a cab is a taxi

explanation.surface: A disliked worker is given his cards in the end and then takes a taxi.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Given his cards' is British for being sacked, which suits the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A scab is a strike-breaker, a worker hated by colleagues for crossing the picket line.

clue.text: Firm with nothing left — worker fluid in a hot situation

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company
O is the zero for nothing
the worker ant is the classic crossword worker

explanation.surface: A company with no money left, with a worker caught in a heated crisis.
explanation.definitionFit: A coolant is a liquid circulated to carry heat away from an engine or reactor.

clue.text: Soldier recalled touching book without one dull moment

indicators.note: called back means turned round, so the whole string is read backwards
without means outside, so the book letter stands beyond the rest

parts.note: re means concerning or touching on
the Roman numeral for one
drab means dull
a mo is a moment

explanation.surface: A soldier remembered moving a book, with not one boring moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recalled' reverses RE + I + DRAB + MO + B, giving REIDRABMOB read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A bombardier is a non-commissioned rank in the British Royal Artillery, equivalent to a corporal.

clue.text: A Bishop observed to be half-hearted attracts church attendance? No!

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

indicators.note: one of the two middle letters of the word for observed is lost, halving its heart

parts.note: seen means observed
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A lukewarm bishop draws people to church; or does he?
explanation.walkthrough: 'attendance? No!' is the opposite of attendance, the definition by negation.
explanation.definitionFit: Absence is the state of not being present, the reverse of turning up.

clue.text: Place of refreshment in desolate place man found heading west

indicators.note: in an across clue, heading west means read from right to left

parts.note: a moor is bleak open upland
Pat is a man's name

explanation.surface: A man walking west across bleak moorland finds a pub.
explanation.definitionFit: A taproom is the bar of a pub or inn where drinks are served.

clue.text: Assumption before the start

parts.note: pre is the prefix meaning before
conception is the very beginning, of life or of an idea

explanation.surface: An assumption made before beginning.
explanation.definitionFit: A preconception is an idea formed in advance, an assumption made before evidence.

clue.text: Support immoral position taken by sportsman

parts.note: to second is to support a motion
base means low and immoral

explanation.surface: Backing an unethical stance adopted by an athlete.
explanation.definitionFit: Second base is a fielding position in baseball, between first and third.

clue.text: Commander once more abandoning home

indicators.note: the letters for home are dropped from the word for once more

parts.note: again means once more
in means at home

explanation.surface: A commander leaving home once again.
explanation.definitionFit: An aga was a military commander or chief officer in the Ottoman Empire.

clue.text: Supporting architect is more intelligent

parts.note: pro means in favour of
the architect of something is its founder

explanation.surface: An architect who backs you is the cleverer one.
explanation.definitionFit: Profound means deep in insight, so its comparative describes a wiser, deeper thinker.

clue.text: Hesitation about going by river? Try again

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the hesitation is read backwards

parts.note: er is the sound of hesitation
the Test is a chalk-stream river in Hampshire, England

explanation.surface: Wavering about walking along a river, someone decides to have another go.
explanation.definitionFit: To retest is to put through an examination or trial a second time.

clue.text: It's strange, being single, strange not to be hugged

indicators.note: the jumbled letters are held inside the word for single

parts.note: unwed means unmarried, single

indicators.note: strange signals that the letters of the word not are jumbled

explanation.surface: It is odd to be unattached and not to be cuddled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strange' appears twice: the first is the definition, the second jumbles the word not before 'to be hugged' tucks it into the word for single.
explanation.definitionFit: Unwonted means unusual or out of the ordinary, the opposite of customary.

clue.text: Strongest deer passes away in shelter

indicators.note: the deer's letters shelter the word for passes away, holding it inside

parts.note: a hart is a male red deer
dies means passes away

explanation.surface: The toughest stag dies in a refuge.
explanation.definitionFit: Hardy means robust and tough, so the superlative describes the most resilient.

clue.text: Well-known female with question expressing self-doubt about honesty

parts.note: am I liar? is what someone doubting their own truthfulness might ask

explanation.surface: A famous woman wonders whether she is honest.
explanation.definitionFit: Familiar means well-known or recognised through frequent encounter.

clue.text: Bloke lacking energy on a lake is a blow

indicators.note: the energy letter is missing from the word for bloke

parts.note: a mister is a man, a bloke
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A listless man by a lake is a disappointment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a blow' is a wind, not a setback: the definition hides in the surface's sense of misfortune.
explanation.definitionFit: The mistral is a strong cold northerly wind that blows down the Rhône valley into southern France.

clue.text: Rare fright when cold is caught

indicators.note: the cold letter is caught inside the word for fright

parts.note: a scare is a fright
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: An unusual scare when someone catches a chill.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarce means in short supply and seldom found, a synonym of rare.

clue.text: Area covered by minister that gives power

indicators.note: the area letter lies within the word for minister

parts.note: a rector is a parish clergyman

explanation.surface: A parish covered by a clergyman who confers authority.
explanation.definitionFit: A nuclear reactor generates the energy used to produce electricity.

clue.text: Like some church services more or less hourly

parts.note: C stands for circa, about, approximately
horal means relating to hours

explanation.surface: Church services held roughly every hour.
explanation.definitionFit: Choral services are sung by a choir, such as choral evensong.

clue.text: Good times of quiet embraced by you and me

indicators.note: the quiet letter is held within the word for you and me

parts.note: us is you and me together
P is piano, the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: Peaceful happy moments shared by the two of us.
explanation.definitionFit: Ups, as in ups and downs, are periods of good fortune.

clue.text: Sailor has mishap with mind distracted

indicators.note: a distracted mind is muddled, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A sailor has an accident because his mind wanders.
explanation.definitionFit: A midshipman is a junior naval officer rank, a type of sailor.

clue.text: Trained as educationist with grasp of one of the basic subjects?

indicators.note: the teaching degree grasps the letter, holding it inside

parts.note: a BEd is a Bachelor of Education, a teaching degree
the three Rs are reading, writing and arithmetic, so R is one of them

explanation.surface: Trained as a teacher who has mastered one of the fundamentals.
explanation.definitionFit: Bred can mean brought up or raised, as in well-bred, so trained in conduct.

clue.text: Return of Communist fury with Russia's leader put out, upset

indicators.note: a return here means a turning back, so the Communist word reads backwards

parts.note: Red is the traditional label for a Communist

indicators.note: the letter picked is put out of the word for fury

parts.note: anger means fury

indicators.note: leader picks the first letter of Russia's

explanation.surface: A Communist returns in a rage, with Russia's leader ousted and upset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Return of' turns RED into DER; 'put out' takes R from ANGER to leave ANGE.
explanation.definitionFit: To derange is to disturb or throw into disorder, especially the mind.

clue.text: Party in Cairo is terrific

indicators.note: the letters needed lie within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A party in the Egyptian capital is marvellous.
explanation.definitionFit: To roister is to celebrate noisily, to party boisterously.

clue.text: River not in good shape — there's little flow here

parts.note: ill means unwell

explanation.surface: A river in poor condition with barely any water moving.
explanation.definitionFit: A rill is a tiny stream, a small flow of water.

clue.text: Old city that's cheerless, in which sailor eats fish

indicators.note: the sailor is placed in the word for cheerless

parts.note: sad means cheerless

indicators.note: the fish is swallowed inside the word for sailor

parts.note: tar is an old word for a sailor
ling is a long-bodied fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A gloomy city where a sailor dines on fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Stalingrad was the former name of Volgograd, the Russian city of the famous WWII battle.
